lldp_enabled.description: Whether to send LLDP packets globally (can be overridden per interface).

cdp_enabled.description: Whether to send CDP packets globally (can be overridden per interface). Note: CDP is Cisco-proprietary.

ttl.description: Time-to-live (seconds) for TLVs received by peers. Must be at least 2× update_interval.

max_queue_len.description: Maximum number of packets to queue per interface (for burst handling).

port_desc_template.description: Template for port description TLV. Supports %h (hostname) and %i (interface name).

hostname.description: Override system hostname for LLDP system name TLV. Leave empty to use system hostname.

interfaces.description: List of interfaces to configure for LLDP/CDP transmission.

lldp_enabled.description: Enable LLDP on this interface (if omitted, uses global setting).

cdp_enabled.description: Enable CDP on this interface (if omitted, uses global setting).

chassis_id.description: Chassis ID TLV value. Use 'auto' to auto-detect MAC, or set explicitly (e.g., '00:11:22:33:44:55').

port_id.description: Port ID TLV value. Use 'auto' to auto-detect interface name, or set explicitly.

sys_name.description: System name TLV value. Use 'auto' to use configured hostname, or set explicitly.

sys_desc.description: System description TLV value. Use 'auto' to auto-generate OS info, or set explicitly.

adv_mgmt_addr.description: Advertise management address TLV for this interface.
